page.overview:
Who is Australovenator?

is an extinct genus of megaraptoran theropod dinosaur that lived in Australia during the Late Cretaceous Period. During the 1900s, it was considered to be an alvarezsaurid or an intermediate theropod. During the 1990s, the dinosaur is believed to be a member of the allosaur family. It was then referred to as the "Polar Allosaur", which also appeared in the famous dinosaur documentary "Walking With Dinosaurs". As of 2009, the theropod was discovered to be a megaraptorid and was named Australovenator. It is considered to be a sister taxon to Fukuiraptor.

Australovenator is possibly illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of the Jurassic Park Institute as a flipped and colored Compsosuchus. However, it hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006.

Aside from that, it is mentioned in the description of Fukuiraptor, being referred to as the Australian species of Allosaurus.

In the Jurassic Park III: Park Builder, you can uncover an Allosaurus in Australia. Given that no animal with the name Allosaurus is currently believed to have existed in Australia it is likely that this creature is based off of Australovenator fossils which were once simply classified as "Allosaurus robustus".
